persons.name: Jayadeva
persons.evidence: jaṭīśvarojayadevo jayamaṃgala iti + + māstribhi prasiddhasya anekaśāstrānukṛtau ṭīkāyāṃ

notes: The date gives two eras that differ by one year. VS 1830 Pauṣa śukla 2 falls around December 1773 or January 1774 CE. ŚS 1694 would correspond to VS 1829, which is about December 1772 or January 1773 CE. The equivalent of VS 1830 is ŚS 1695. Possible causes are a scribal slip or a mix of expired and current years. VS is taken as primary. Three characters are lost between the two years ('+ + +'). 'saṃkhyā 1500' is the granthasaṃkhyā. The commentator is given as 'jaṭīśvaro jayadevo jayamaṃgala iti ... prasiddhasya', which is partly lacunose. Jayamaṅgalā is the name of the well-known Bhaṭṭikāvya commentary, which is traditionally ascribed to Jayamaṅgala or Jaya(deva). Here the commentator is taken to be Jayadeva, also called Jaṭīśvara, but the alternative reading 'Jayamaṅgala' as a personal name cannot be excluded. The author's father 'śrīsvāmin' could also be read as the proper name Śrīsvāmin; tradition calls Bhaṭṭi 'Śrīsvāmisūnu' or the son of Śrīdharasvāmin. The catalogue gives King: Narendradeva and Donor: Śrīkṛṣṇajośī Rāmanagara, but neither appears in the quoted colophon; they may come from another part of the MS. The catalogue's 'Place of Copying: Vallabhī' is the author's residence, not the place where this copy was made. The colophon names no scribe or commissioner.
